@action.description: Action type for interval tool call review.

decision.description: The decision for the tool execution. 'continue' means the tool should keep running, 'cancel' means the tool execution should be stopped. 'detach' preserves this running execution in the background so the agent can continue; use only when runtime supports detachment.

reason.description: A brief explanation for the decision, explaining why you chose to continue, cancel or detach.

progress_summary.description: A summary of what the tool has accomplished so far based on the output.

estimated_remaining_time.description: Your estimate of how much longer the tool might need to complete, if continuing.
